description_full: PROJECT SEARCH INFORMATION SESSION Wednesday, December 2, 2026 6:00-7:00 p.m. Virtual Event Project SEARCH is a work-transition program that prepares young adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities in their last year of high school for competitive employment. Candidates for the 2027-2028 school year must meet ALL eligibility requirements, including, but not limited to: ● Be 18-21 years old and entering last year of high school ● Desire to obtain competitive integrated employment ● Vocational Rehabilitation (VR) eligibility through DORS ● DDA Eligibility (cannot accept "Supports Only") ● Maintain appropriate workplace behavior & hygiene ● Prior work experience and ability to work for up to 4 hours a day without direct supervision For questions, please contact Missie Baxter at missie_baxter@hcpss.org . Visit Google Meet link. meet.google.com/tpz-ossv-eob Please complete this information form before the meeting if possible. https://forms.gle/MoiNgyFehFmAXcgQ7 This event is sponsored by HCPSS and aligns with the questions about the school system offering training about special education issues and providing information on agencies that can assist in the transition from school on the MDSE parent survey that is sent to families of students with an IEP or IFSP annually. Free
